title: Transparent strategy (+platform), PhP  Fund
tagline: Transparent strategies of digital asset, backtest/ future performance assess, shared to community
description:
This repo will contain quant methods to evaluate crypto yield strategies, and we hope it will be simple enough that a 12 year old student or a 70 yo man can use it.

Reliable, simple to follow.

We acknowledge: not everything will be 100% reliable or can be fully automated under limited resource

### Key deliverables:

* Use previous data to back test

* back test other strategies contributed by future contributors 

* share results in protocols such as Ocean Protocol Provider
how_its_made:
We use:



React as front end, 

Python to do performance backtest/prediction, 

and connect to Ocean Protocol Provider to save and share digital asset



There are some difficulty in running Provider and I will continue to work on it. Ocean Protocol has enough documentation for me to explore and the design is good - file/data is stored in location that I have control.
